lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Highly organized grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in at least ten distinct vertical columns posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the centers of the circular spot columns, creating a visible intersecting grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp intensity gradient transition from a light dorsal surface to a shadowed ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs concentrated within the visible lower-anterior and mid-section of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (commensal organisms) are clustered beneath the primary pectoral fin and along the ventral midline.
